Mojiworld — Sound Review

Monster hit sounds, monster death sounds and NPC voices, all in one place. Listen, say what you think, send it back.

How to use this page

  1. Press ▶ to hear a sound. The name next to it tells you which creature or character it belongs to, and when you'd hear it in the game.
  2. Give it a verdict — 👍 Good, 🤔 Not sure, or 👎 Needs work. That's all that's needed for most sounds.
  3. Add a comment when something is off. Say what's wrong and what it should sound like instead — for example "too metallic, should be a wet squelch and about half as long". That sentence is the most useful thing you can give us.
  4. When you're done (or want a break), scroll to the bottom and press Copy everything. Then paste it into a message and send it. Your work is saved automatically in this browser, so you can close the page and come back to it.

Faster with the keyboard: Space play · 1 good · 2 not sure · 3 needs work · ↓ / ↑ move · Enter jump into the comment box.

⚠ This browser won't let the page save your progress automatically (private/incognito mode does this). Your notes will still work, but press "Copy everything" or "Download" before closing the tab or they'll be lost.
